name: sdlc
description: Actual's development workflow for Claude Code: Linear issues, translation, and (soon) spec, ticket, and triage commands.

auto_translate.title: Auto-translate Linear issues
auto_translate.description: When on, pasting a Linear issue URL into a prompt translates the issue to Bahasa Indonesia first.

translate_provider.title: Translation provider
translate_provider.description: Model provider used for translation. Its API key must be set in your shell environment.

translate_model.title: Translation model
translate_model.description: Model ID override. Leave empty for the provider default (required for openai and openrouter).
